title: strict parameter of base64_decode
summary: When strict is turned off, invalid letters may be discarded; when turned on, input containing characters outside the alphabet may return false.
detail: Taking SGV!sbG8= as an example, the relaxed mode still solves Hello, but the strict mode reports failure.
boundary: The return value of strict may also be a legal empty string. If the check fails, the empty string should be distinguished from false.
relevance: Distinguish between attachments that really contain exclamation marks and decoders that silently ignore exclamation marks.
